entities.summary: The Musée de la Magie, also known as the Musée de la Curiosité et de la Magie and the Académie de la Magie, is a private museum located in the 4th arrondissement at 11, rue saint Paul in Paris, France. It is open several afternoons per week; an admission fee is charged.
